import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_map = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for i, disorder in enumerate(sleep_disorder_map.unique()):
    mask = sleep_disorder_map == disorder
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Sleep Duration'], df[mask]['Quality of Sleep'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=80, label=disorder, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age distribution by Gender
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
df.boxplot(column='Age', by='Gender', ax=ax2, patch_artist=True)
ax2.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Age', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.sca(ax2)
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
ax2.get_figure().suptitle('')

# 3. Physical Activity Level vs Stress Level
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', 
                     alpha=0.6, s=60, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress\n(colored by Sleep Quality)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Quality', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. BMI Category distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax4.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation (top 10)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True).tail(10)
occupation_sleep.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax5, color=colors[3])
ax5.set_xlabel('Avg Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Top 10 Occupations by\nAvg Sleep Duration', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Heart Rate vs Daily Steps
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax6.scatter(df['Daily Steps'], df['Heart Rate'], alpha=0.5, s=50, color=colors[5], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
z = np.polyfit(df['Daily Steps'], df['Heart Rate'], 1)
p = np.poly1d(z)
ax6.plot(df['Daily Steps'], p(df['Daily Steps']), "r--", alpha=0.8, linewidth=2)
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 7. Sleep Disorder prevalence by Gender
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
disorder_gender = pd.crosstab(df['Gender'], df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None'))
disorder_gender.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax7, color=colors[:len(disorder_gender.columns)], width=0.7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', frameon=True)
ax7.set_xticklabels(ax7.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Correlation heatmap of key metrics
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
corr_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
             'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[corr_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            square=True, ax=ax8, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, annot_kws={'fontsize': 8})
ax8.set_title('Correlation Heatmap', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xticklabels(ax8.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax8.set_yticklabels(ax8.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=8)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analytics Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
